Definition: of uncertain origin; Lois, a Christian woman:--Lois.
BiblicalUsage: Lōḯs is the name of Lois. In 2 Timothy 1:5, "which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lois is the grandmother every family needs — the unfeigned faith that dwelt first in her, then in Eunice, then in Timothy. I hold that faith passed down is the truest inheritance.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
